reviews.review:
Denny Crane here to tell you to buy this video game. Guns, guns, and more guns is what you get. What you don't get is Ms. Weaver in her underwear. When you think you have beaten this video game you learn that there are harder difficulties, which only ups the fun and action. Never will you fully understand how your specific Marine will play out until you completely level up his abilities to the maximum. Not to mention there are multiple "classes" to do just that. More so they give you another "class" just by beating the video game once over. All this contained on your one Marine.
There is one draw back: almost no way to communicate with your teammates. No typing and no built in voice communication program. However, this does cut down on the chit chat, and hearing a woman complain she doesn't like being told no one will sleep with her because she sounds ugly. If she doesn't want to live up to her God-given purpose then she shouldn't talk. Also, lose some weight, fatty. With that said, this video game DOES give you a way to display context sensitive targets and give orders so there is that.
Guns, violence, Mexican-cussing, and numerous ways to customize your Marine. Denny Crane.

Short and boring.
Play World war z much better.

Co-op third person shooter for three, also works tolerably for solo.

The 12 missions available feature well-made environments with a nice Aliens (1986) colonial marine feel to them, good stories, good voice acting banter.

Clever incentives to try different classes ("kits") and loadouts, as well as interesting ways to customize them. I'm having fun.

Best Aliens game so far. It could be better if there were more content and additional stage bosses and some horror elements too.  Otherwise its an action packed game. Hopefully they add some guest heroes like Ripley, Bishop or those characters from Prometheus. That would be awesome!
